data.name: Sloane
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘slāan’, meaning ‘to cleave or cut’. The name Sloane has an Old English origin and coming from the term ‘slāne’, which means ‘stream’ or ‘meadow’. This name can also be traced back to the Old Irish ‘sluain’, meaning ‘warrior status’ or ‘condition of peace’. As a female name, Sloane has been associated with strength, beauty, and grace. It is also considered a unisex name and can be used for boys.

in_greek.name: Σλόαν

in_greek.long_meaning: Το Σλόαν είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την αγγλική γλώσσα, αλλά έχει συνδεθεί με την ελληνική παράδοση.
